title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Keep Losses Affordable to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 USDT in capital, 2% means a maximum loss of 200 USDT per trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account is down just 20%, a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in and lose 30% each time,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it to break even—mathematically, you’re almost as good as finished.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%.” It’s “when this trade hits its stop-loss, the amount you lose
must not exceed 2%.” So the right sequence is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine your position size.

Ethereum Foundation launches public infrastructure feature｜Bhutan’s digital ID as a case study｜For ETH, watch fund flows first

My view is that I support the direction of these applications, but I’m not chasing the phrase “government on-chain.” Today, the Ethereum Foundation published “Designing for Agency: Ethereum and Digital Public Infrastructure” and launched a new feature website for the public sector. The article discusses how governments and nonprofits can verify credentials and coordinate services on shared networks, using Bhutan’s national digital identity system as a case study. The Foundation’s case study page further explains that Bhutan’s NDI stores credentials in personal wallets, while shared registry information on Ethereum helps service providers verify credential issuers and formats; sensitive personal information is not written directly to Ethereum for public access. This kind of “adoption” is part of the verification architecture; it does not mean that every identity check generates a mainnet transaction.

What interests me is long-term verifiability and reducing institutions’ reliance on a single service provider. If more institutions adopt public, independently verifiable registry layers, that could create demand for development tools, settlement, and security services. But identity verification usage cannot simply be multiplied by ETH fees, and the Foundation’s case study should not be presented as a country announcing today that it is adding to its ETH holdings. The Foundation also mentioned a proof of concept for coordinating humanitarian aid, but this is still prototype exploration, not evidence that a large-scale payment network is already live. For holders, what matters more is whether there are further real-world deployments, which layer transaction activity takes place on, and whether that activity can generate sustained economic demand for ETH.

Price and fund flows have poured a little cold water on this long-term narrative. I just checked Kraken: ETH/USD is around $2,268, with a 24-hour low of $2,233.51 and a high of $2,300. The price is above today’s open of about $2,249, but has yet to break above the previous high. Farside shows total net outflows of $139.7 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 2, including $138.3 million from ETHA. A small number of products saw modest inflows, so it would be inaccurate to say that all funds are retreating in unison. On the macro front, the Federal Reserve held its interest rate range at 3.75% to 4% on October 28. Current trending topics on Square are mainly Binance withdrawals and proof of reserves, among others. I haven’t seen an accurate trending tag for the public infrastructure feature, so I’m only tagging the ETH actually discussed here.

My key levels are whether ETH can reclaim $2,300 and whether $2,233.51 holds. If fund outflows continue and the project case studies are not followed by more verifiable real-world usage data, I would reconsider the thesis that public-sector adoption can support ETH’s valuation in the short term. Conversely, even if the price breaks out, we need to distinguish improving market risk appetite from real on-chain demand generated by the case study itself. Previous announcements about the restoration of exchange security only describe service progress; they don’t mean that Ethereum has experienced a new fault or that all withdrawal issues have been resolved.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and only consider a spot long. I would only open a position using 2% of my total capital if ETH decisively reclaims $2,300 and holds above it on a retest, and the next round of fund data does not deteriorate significantly further. My first target would be $2,335; I’d take half off there and move the stop on the remaining position up to breakeven. My second target would be $2,370, though I’d close early if volume is insufficient. I’d set a hard stop just below $2,233. If the price breaks out but quickly falls back below $2,300 and cannot reclaim it, or if a new, verified security incident emerges, I’d also exit proactively. If no trigger occurs, I’ll remain flat—I won’t present observation as profit.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

以太坊基金会推出公共基础设施专题｜不丹数字身份是案例｜ETH先看资金验证

我的态度是认可应用方向，但不追“政府上链”四个字。以太坊基金会今天发布《为自主性设计：以太坊与数字公共基础设施》，同时上线面向公共部门的新专题网站。文章讨论政府、非营利组织如何在共享网络上验证凭证、协调服务，并以不丹国家数字身份系统为案例。基金会专题的案例页进一步写明：不丹NDI将凭证保存在个人钱包中，以太坊上的共享登记信息帮助服务方核对凭证签发者与格式；个人敏感资料并未直接公开写入以太坊。这里的“采用”是验证架构的一部分，不代表每一次身份核验都会产生一笔主网交易。

我关心的机制是长期可验证性和机构之间减少对单一服务商的依赖。若更多机构采用公开、可独立核查的登记层，可能带来开发工具、结算和安全服务需求；但身份认证本身的使用量不能直接乘以ETH手续费，也不能把基金会案例写成今天某国宣布增持ETH。基金会同时提到人道援助协调的概念验证，性质仍是原型探索，不能当成大规模支付网络已投产。对持币者更重要的是后续有哪些真实部署、交易活动落在哪一层，以及这些活动能否产生持续的ETH经济需求。

价格和资金给这个长期叙事泼了点冷水。刚查Kraken ETH/USD约2268美元，24小时低点2233.51、高点2300美元；价格高于今日日开约2249美元，但还没越过前高。Farside显示11月2日美国现货ETH基金合计净流出1.397亿美元，其中ETHA流出1.383亿美元，少数产品有小幅流入，不能说所有基金同步撤退。宏观上，美联储10月28日维持3.75%至4%的利率区间。广场当前热点主要是币安提现、储备证明等，我没有看到公共基础设施专题的准确热门标签，因此只标注实际讨论的ETH。

我的关键位是2300美元能否收复，2233.51美元是否守住。若基金净流出延续，而项目案例迟迟没有更多可验证的实际使用数据，我会推翻“公共部门采用能在短期支持ETH估值”的推论；反过来，即使价格突破，也要区分市场风险偏好改善和案例本身带来的真实链上需求。此前关于交易所安全恢复的公告只说明服务进度，不是以太坊网络新增了故障或已经解决了所有提现问题。

如果是我自己交易，当前不参与，方向只考虑现货多头。只有ETH有效收复2300美元并回踩站稳，且下一轮基金数据没有继续明显恶化，我才用总资金2%试仓。第一目标2335美元，触及减半并把余仓止损抬至成本；第二目标看2370美元，若量能不足就提前平仓。硬止损设在2233美元下方；若突破后迅速跌回2300美元下方并无法收复，或出现新的已证实安全事件，也会主动平仓。没有触发就维持空仓，不把观察写成收益。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

The Ethereum network is improving, yet ETH is struggling to gain value. Whether this divergence can persist depends on which of two sources of capital turns first: whether ETFs return to net inflows, and whether corporate treasuries stop using cash to buy back shares. My view is that short-term pressure is coming more from the holder base than from demand for on-chain usage.

First, the facts. According to PANews, U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs saw net outflows of more than $1.2 billion in October, led by BlackRock’s ETHA. Since January this year, inflows have occurred in only two months. One reason is that ETFs cannot stake, so holders miss out on on-chain yield. Another source of capital is corporate treasuries: BitMine holds about 6.06 million ETH, nearly 5% of the circulating supply, at an average cost of around $3,500. With the price near $2,300, its unrealized losses exceed $4 billion. In the past week, it bought back $45.9 million of its own shares but purchased only $24.5 million in crypto. Its shares trade at just 0.88 times net asset value, making it more attractive to use cash from staking to buy back discounted shares than to keep adding to its crypto holdings.

The inference is that these two capital flows have one thing in common: marginal buyers of ETH are pulling back. ETF holders bear an opportunity cost without earning a return, while corporate treasuries nearing their self-imposed limits are prioritizing buybacks with their cash. Meanwhile, about 1.37 million ETH are waiting in the on-chain staking activation queue, with a wait of more than 24 days; only about 13,000 ETH are queued to exit. The willingness to give up liquidity for 2.61% yield suggests that long-term holders are still present, but the growing lockup period is slowing the conversion of holdings into cash.

There is another mechanism worth noting: as mainnet fees have fallen, the base fee is now just 0.06 Gwei. It would take 13.63 Gwei for burns to match issuance, and the network is currently adding about 2,954 ETH a day on a net basis. With the deflationary engine switched off, improvements to the network do not automatically translate into greater scarcity for the token.

What would invalidate this view: if the ETH/BTC exchange rate stops falling and rebounds, ETF weekly net flows turn positive, and the staking queue shrinks significantly, that would indicate easing marginal selling pressure. Conversely, if corporate treasuries continue to prioritize buybacks and ETFs keep seeing outflows, the pressure could persist. This article does not constitute investment advice.

$BTC

以太坊网络在变好，ETH却卖不上价，这个背离能否持续，取决于两股资金谁先转向：ETF能否恢复净流入，以及企业金库是否停止用现金回购股票。我的观察是，短期压力更多来自持有结构，而非链上使用需求。

先看事实。据PANews报道，10月美国以太坊现货ETF净流出超12亿美元，贝莱德ETHA领衔；今年1月以来资金只进过两个月。原因之一是ETF不能质押，持有者拿不到链上利息。另一条资金链是企业金库：BitMine持有约606万枚ETH，占流通量近5%，均价成本约3500美元，现价2300美元附近，浮亏超40亿美元；最近一周回购自家股票4590万美元，买币仅2450万美元。其股价只有净资产的0.88倍，用质押现金回购折价股份，比继续加仓更划算。

据此推断，这两条链的共同点是：ETH的边际买家正在收手。ETF持有者承担机会成本却无收益，企业金库逼近自设上限后把现金优先用于回购。与此同时，链上约137万枚ETH排队等激活质押，需等24天以上，退出仅约1.3万枚。资金愿意放弃流动性换2.61%的利息，说明长期持有者仍在，但锁仓拉长了变现周期。

还有一个机制值得注意：主网手续费下降后，基础费率仅0.06 Gwei，销毁追平增发需要13.63 Gwei，全网每天净增发约2954枚ETH。通缩引擎熄火，意味着网络变好并不自动传导为代币稀缺。

判断失效的条件：若ETH/BTC汇率止跌回升、ETF周度净流转正、质押排队明显缩短，说明边际卖压缓解。反之，若企业金库继续以回购优先、ETF持续流出，压力可能延续。本文不构成投资建议。

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Institutions Continue to Accumulate, While Short-Term Overbought Technical Conditions Call for Caution About a Pullback

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of 6:00 p.m. Beijing time on November 3, 2026, the spot price of Ethereum was $2,270, down approximately 0.80% over the past 24 hours. Looking at the hourly candlestick chart, Ethereum has steadily climbed over the past five hours. Starting from an opening price of $2,246, it briefly retested support at $2,250 before gradually rising to an intraday high of $2,272, then consolidating within a narrow range around $2,270.

In terms of market drivers, Ethereum is currently caught between opposing bullish and bearish forces. On the positive side, corporate buying continues to grow, with institutional Ethereum reserves increasing by 5,000 ETH. Major companies now hold a total of 6.065 million ETH, approximately 4.96% of the circulating supply. The spot market saw net inflows late in the session, with net hourly inflows turning positive at $45.2 million, driven by large orders and lifting the price from $2,246 to above $2,268.

On the negative side, institutional spot ETFs continue to record net outflows. On November 2, daily net outflows reached $139.7 million, and the monthly redemption trend is ongoing. In addition, a security incident at an external platform led to tens of thousands of ETH being illicitly transferred, creating persistent on-chain selling pressure. Binance’s publication of a zero-knowledge proof of reserves covering the top ten tokens, including ETH, has somewhat eased concerns about exchange liquidity.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

In terms of moving averages, Ethereum’s current price of $2,270 is above the 7-day moving average at $2,260 and the 25-day moving average at $2,263, and is close to the 99-day moving average at $2,260. Short-term moving averages are beginning to flatten and curl slightly upward. The price and moving averages are converging, a typical pattern ahead of a directional move.

For the MACD, the DIF line is at -1.71, the signal line at -4.29, and the histogram at 2.58. Although the MACD remains below the zero line, the histogram has expanded for three consecutive periods and the DIF line is rapidly approaching the signal line, with a bullish crossover possible in the short term. This is a positive sign that momentum is shifting from bearish to bullish.

The 6-period RSI has risen to 69.90, approaching the overbought threshold of 70. The 12-period RSI is 57.60, and the 24-period RSI is 52.47. The short-term RSI is rising strongly, while the medium- and long-term RSIs have also returned to neutral-to-strong territory. Overall momentum is improving, but short-term overbought pressure is building.

For the KDJ indicator, the K value is 83.54, the D value is 69.21, and the J value is 112.19. All three lines are at elevated levels, with the J value above 100 and in overbought territory. The Stochastic RSI has reached an extreme reading of 99.39, indicating a clear short-term overbought signal.

The Bollinger Band upper line is at $2,272, the middle line at $2,258, and the lower line at $2,243. The price has reached the area near the upper band, while the bands continue to narrow, suggesting a potential short-term retest of the middle band.

The Williams %R is -6.04, indicating deeply overbought conditions. The Parabolic SAR is at $2,244, below the price, maintaining a bullish signal. The 14-period ATR is $12.82. Volatility continues to decline, and the market is in a low-volatility consolidation phase.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum market sentiment has recently been cautiously optimistic. On-chain data shows corporate buyers continuing to accumulate at lower levels, with their total holdings now accounting for nearly 5% of the circulating supply. This indicates a strategic allocation reflecting a long-term bullish outlook on Ethereum. The publication of Binance’s proof of reserves and the gradual restoration of exchange withdrawal channels have also helped stabilize market confidence.

There has been positive news on the regulatory front. Staff at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission explicitly stated that governance tokens such as Uniswap’s UNI do not automatically constitute securities. This provides holders of DeFi governance tokens with a clearer legal framework and could attract more institutions to participate in on-chain governance. The ruling offers positive support for the DeFi sector across the Ethereum ecosystem.

Security incidents remain a key market concern. Brazil’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, Mercado Bitcoin, suffered a $46 million hack. Combined with the earlier loss of $133 million by an EU financial institution across multiple centralized exchanges, total cryptocurrency hacking losses in 2026 have reached $8.74 billion—more than three times the total for all of 2025. These incidents remind investors to pay attention to asset security.

Overall, Ethereum’s short-term technical momentum is improving, with the MACD approaching a bullish crossover and the price above the short-term moving averages. However, the Stochastic RSI and Williams %R are both in extremely overbought territory, so the risk of a short-term pullback should not be ignored. $2,272 is short-term resistance, while $2,243, the lower Bollinger Band, is support. Investors are advised to monitor changes in ETF fund flows and corporate buying activity, and to manage position sizes carefully.

以太坊市场深度分析：机构持续增持，技术面短期超买需警惕回调

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间二零二六年十一月三日下午六点，以太坊现货价格报二千二百七十美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之零点八零。从小时级别K线观察，以太坊在过去五个小时内呈现稳步攀升的走势。价格从二千二百四十六美元的开盘位起步，经过短暂回踩二千二百五十美元支撑后，逐步上行至二千二百七十二美元的日内高点，随后在二千二百七十美元附近窄幅整理。

从驱动因素来看，以太坊当前受到多空两股力量的拉锯。利好方面，企业级买盘持续加码，机构以太坊储备增加了五千枚ETH，主要企业持仓总量已达六百零六万五千枚ETH，约占流通供应量的百分之四点九六。尾盘现货市场出现净流入，净小时流入转正至四千五百二十万美元，由大单推动，带动价格从二千二百四十六美元回升至二千二百六十八美元以上。

利空方面，机构现货ETF持续录得净流出，十一月二日单日净流出达一亿三千九百七十万美元，月度赎回趋势仍在延续。此外，外部平台的安全事件导致数万枚ETH被非法转出，形成链上持续的抛压。币安发布的零知识证明储备证明覆盖了ETH在内的十大代币，一定程度缓解了交易所流动性担忧。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，以太坊当前价格二千二百七十美元已站上七日均线二千二百六十美元和二十五日均线二千二百六十三美元，接近九十九日均线二千二百六十美元。短期均线开始走平并微微上翘，价格与均线系统趋于粘合，这是方向选择前的典型形态。

MACD指标方面，DIF线负一点七一，信号线负四点二九，柱状图二点五八。MACD虽然仍在零轴下方，但柱状图连续三个周期放大且DIF线快速向信号线靠拢，短期内有望形成金叉。这是动能由空转多的积极信号。

RSI六周期指标升至六十九点九零，接近七十的超买线。RSI十二周期为五十七点六零，RSI二十四周期为五十二点四七。短周期RSI强势上行，中长周期RSI也回到中性偏强区域，整体动能向好但短线面临超买压力。

KDJ指标中K值八十三点五四，D值六十九点二一，J值一百一十二点一九。三线均处于高位，J值超过一百进入超买区间。随机RSI指标达到九十九点三九的极值，短线超买信号明显。

布林带上轨二千二百七十二美元，中轨二千二百五十八美元，下轨二千二百四十三美元。价格已触及上轨附近，带宽持续收窄，短期内存在回踩中轨的需求。

威廉指标负六点零四，深度超买区域。抛物线SAR指标二千二百四十四美元，位于价格下方，维持看涨信号。ATR十四周期为十二点八二美元，波动率持续下降，市场处于低波动蓄势阶段。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪近期呈现谨慎乐观的格局。从链上数据来看，企业级买家在低位持续增持，总持仓已占流通量的近百分之五，显示出长期看好以太坊的战略配置意图。币安储备证明的发布和交易所提现通道的逐步恢复，也有助于稳定市场信心。

监管层面传来利好消息。美国证券交易委员会工作人员明确表示，Uniswap的UNI等治理代币不自动构成证券，这为DeFi治理代币持有者提供了更明确的法律框架，有望吸引更多机构参与链上治理。这一裁定对整个以太坊生态的DeFi板块构成正面支撑。

安全事件仍是市场关注焦点。巴西最大加密货币交易所Mercado Bitcoin遭遇四千六百万美元黑客攻击，加上此前欧盟某金融机构在多个中心化交易所损失一亿三千三百万美元，二零二六年加密货币黑客损失总额已达八十七点四亿美元，超过二零二五年全年的三倍以上。这些事件提醒投资者注意资产安全。

综合来看，以太坊短期技术面动能向好，MACD即将金叉，价格站上短期均线。但随机RSI和威廉指标均处于极度超买区域，短线回调风险不容忽视。二千二百七十二美元为短期阻力，二千二百四十三美元为布林带下轨支撑。建议投资者关注ETF资金流向变化和企业买盘动态，控制好仓位。

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scale Out to Take Profits: How to Lock in Gains While Letting Profits Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than cutting losses, because a stop-loss cuts into your fear, while taking profits cuts into your greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—then the price pulls back and you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking strategy I've been using.

[Three stages] Stage one: When the price reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell a third to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade is risk-free, and your mindset immediately changes. Stage two: When the price reaches the second target,
(for example, a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio), sell another third. Stage three: Let a trailing stop manage the rest; exit if the price falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

[Why this works] If you close the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up riding it all the way back to breakeven.

ETH is trading at $2,268.12 today, down 0.7% over 24 hours; it was around $2,312 a week ago. I didn’t save a comparable snapshot from a month ago, so I won’t make up a figure from memory. What I can confirm is that it’s down 54.1% from its ATH, and the Fear & Greed Index has fallen to 26, with a weekly average of 37.

Trading volume remains active, but sentiment has softened first, suggesting that capital is waiting for a catalyst. Support is at 2,190.6 and resistance at 2,342.46. The range doesn’t make the call for me; the main question is whether ETH can move from “buying coins” to real-world applications.

The parties affected and the exchanges have yet to confirm the $106 million theft involving an ETH transaction route. In practice, users, exchanges, and regulated custodians will all be affected: efficient transfers matter, but auditability, traceability, and the ability to reimburse losses are also the price of admission for institutions. Ultimately, the business case comes down to who bears the cost of risk.

Ether funds saw $1.61 billion in outflows in a single month, while Bitmine continued to accumulate, nearing its target of 5% of the supply. Risk capital pulling back and strategic capital allocating funds aren’t contradictory. For ETH to strengthen again, we’ll need to see applications and revenue. One thing I still can’t figure out: will waiting give rise to applications, or to leverage?

Which matters more to you: a breakout from this range, or whether “real buying” can translate into actual use?

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

Where you place your stop-loss takes more thought than whether to use one at all. Too tight, and you get stopped out every day; too wide, and one loss can hurt badly.

to build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop might end up right where other traders’ stops are clustered.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place your stop where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is: if the price breaks through this level, it’s evidence that I was wrong.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

【State 1: Funding rates stay strongly positive】This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a top, and a sharp drop from a long squeeze could happen at any moment. I’m not telling you to immediately
short; rather, be extra careful about chasing longs at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

【State 2: Funding rates stay negative】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to exit has already done so, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past have started at moments like this.

‎GAME THEORY: чотири генерали та проблема довіри

‎Метафора «чотирьох генералів» тут — не буквальна класична задача візантійських генералів, а модель стратегічної взаємодії учасників із неповною інформацією. Учасники не лише не довіряють один одному, а й мають різні цілі, різні джерела інформації та різні можливості впливати на результат.

‎Генерал №1 — Сполучені Штати

‎Стимул — швидко встановити відповідального, якщо атрибуція достатньо обґрунтована. Це дозволяє продемонструвати ефективність правоохоронців, попередити інші угруповання, мобілізувати партнерів і створити правову основу для санкцій.

‎Обмеження: якщо незалежні технічні докази будуть переконливими, постійне заперечення лише посилить міжнародну недовіру. Мета Пхеньяна — не допустити, щоб американська версія стала єдиною прийнятною інтерпретацією.

‎Головний пріоритет — зберегти довіру користувачів. Стимул демонструвати фінансову стійкість, здатність компенсувати збитки, контроль над інфраструктурою та співпрацю з правоохоронцями.

‎Це не обов’язково конкретна держава. Це будь-який актор, який може отримати вигоду від помилкової атрибуції: інша кібергрупа, незалежний хакер, підрозділ третьої країни, посередник, що використовує чужі методи, або учасник внутрішнього ланцюга доступу.

Це не означає, що такий гравець існує в конкретній справі, — але якісне розслідування не повинно виключати альтернативні гіпотези лише через репутацію найбільш очевидного підозрюваного.

‎У теорії ігор рівновага не означає, що всі учасники задоволені або говорять правду. Рівновага Неша — це ситуація, коли жоден учасник не може покращити власний результат, односторонньо змінюючи стратегію.

‎Тому «гра без рівноваги» — радше аналітична метафора, ніж строгий математичний висновок. У справі Binance може існувати рівновага, в якій США продовжують звинувачувати КНДР, Пхеньян заперечує, Binance компенсує збитки, а альтернативні виконавці залишаються поза увагою.

‎Така ситуація може бути стабільною, навіть якщо істина не встановлена повністю. Парадокс: стратегічна стабільність не гарантує фактичної правильності. Саме це і є головна проблема асиметрії інформації.

‎Репутація — це напрямок розслідування. Не доказ вини.

‎ECONOMICS: «Дядько Сем заліз до власної кишені»

‎Іронія заголовка полягає в тому, що американська влада звинувачує КНДР, але фінансові наслідки атаки спочатку бере на себе Binance.

‎Проте важливо не плутати фінансові ролі. Binance покриває втрати власними ресурсами, резервом SAFU та іншими фондами. США не оголошували, що компенсують біржі збитки. Тому «Дядько Сем заліз до власної кишені» — не буквальний опис американських платежів, а метафора ситуації, в якій геополітичне звинувачення повертається до американської фінансової та технологічної системи через санкції, блокування активів, розслідування та участь емітентів стейблкоїнів.

‎І тут є ще один принциповий аспект: компенсація збитків і повернення викраденого — два різні процеси. Binance може поповнити резерви, але це не означає, що викрадені активи повернулися до початкових гаманців.

‎Чому ця історія важлива поза криптовалютою

‎Перша зміна — кіберпростір став частиною геополітики. Держави використовують цифрові атаки, санкції, блокування активів і публічну атрибуцію як інструменти міжнародної конкуренції.

‎Друга — блокчейн не усуває державний контроль. Публічність транзакцій дозволяє відстежувати рух активів, а централізовані емітенти стейблкоїнів можуть блокувати окремі адреси.

‎Третя — довіра стала фінансовим активом. Binance змушена демонструвати не лише технологічну безпеку, а й здатність компенсувати збитки. Для централізованої біржі репутація може бути не менш важливою, ніж резерви.

‎DECISION: практичні поради для читача DVA

‎Головний урок не в тому, щоб повірити ФБР або КНДР. Він у тому, щоб розуміти структуру ризику і діяти до того, як станеться наступний інцидент.

‎Рівень 1. Структура зберігання

‎Не тримайте весь капітал на одній платформі — диверсифікація кастодіальних ризиків є базовим принципом. Розділяйте три кошики: торговий (на біржі), операційний (гаманець для частих операцій) і резервний (холодне зберігання). Для довгострокового зберігання використовуйте апаратний або інший надійний некастодіальний гаманець.

‎Пам’ятайте: самостійне зберігання теж створює ризики — втрата seed, фішинг, компрометація пристрою. Це не «безпечно за замовчуванням», це інший набір ризиків.

‎Рівень 2. Гігієна облікового запису

‎Використовуйте апаратні ключі (FIDO2/WebAuthn) замість SMS-2FA, оскільки SMS вразливий до SIM-swap. Тримайте окрему пошту та окремий пристрій для криптоакаунтів. Вмикайте whitelist адрес для виведення там, де біржа це підтримує. Перевіряйте домен щоразу, а не лише за першим входом: фішинг еволюціонує швидше за звички.

‎Рівень 3. Перевірка біржі перед довірою

‎Proof of Reserves ≠ аудит безпеки. PoR показує, що активи є, але не гарантує, що інфраструктура захищена. Дивіться на історію інцидентів і на те, як біржа їх закривала: компенсація важлива, але причина атаки важливіша. Перевіряйте реальну доступність виведення невеликою сумою — це найкращий стрес-тест. Оцінюйте, чи є в біржі публічний механізм покриття збитків (SAFU-подібні фонди).
‎

The U.S. midterm elections begin next week, making them one of the events the crypto market has been watching most closely in recent weeks. Bitcoin closed the month near its 100-day moving average, and the whole market is now waiting to see how prices react once the election results are announced. These elections could affect not only the U.S. government but also, indirectly, tech company earnings and crypto regulation, so Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies are watching anxiously.

Why does this news matter?
The U.S. midterm elections are more than an ordinary political event for the crypto market. They have a direct bearing on the direction of U.S. tech policy and cryptocurrency regulation over the next few years. If the results leave Democrats in control of Congress, they could lead to more crypto-friendly legislation. But if Republicans take control, the regulatory environment could become stricter. The market has already priced in some expectations; the key question is whether the results will exceed them. As “digital gold,” Bitcoin often fluctuates in response to risk aversion and regulatory concerns.

Impact on the market
The elections’ short-term impact on the market may be more about shifts in sentiment than a change in trend. If Bitcoin falls below the monthly closing price of 76,990, it could trigger more profit-taking. But as long as it holds above the 100-day moving average, the medium-term trend is unlikely to break easily. Historical data shows that after major political events, Bitcoin typically fluctuates by 20–30% in the short term, but ultimately returns to following the fundamentals. Crypto assets such as ETH and BNB will follow BTC’s lead, but with greater volatility.

Trading approach
At present, if the U.S. midterm election results meet market expectations, Bitcoin may continue to trade in a narrow range, searching for direction between 76,000 and 78,000. 📰 Mining turns to natural gas: Why has Cipher suddenly changed direction with its computing power expansion?

Computing power provider Cipher just announced it would scale back its grid-powered expansion plans from 4.6 GW to 3.4 GW, while increasing its support for natural gas power generation, with a target of 5.9 GW in total computing power. Behind this decision is declining Bitcoin mining revenue: Cipher is looking to diversify its energy mix to stay afloat.

Why does this news matter?

Computing power providers are broadly facing a cost crisis. As difficulty on the BTC mainnet continues to rise, the cost of mining computing power keeps climbing, while revenue fluctuates with the price. Cipher's proactive adjustment to its energy mix means the industry is beginning to seriously consider alternatives to the traditional power grid. Natural gas, with its relatively stable costs and controllable supply, could become a new favorite. This reflects a shift in the computing power industry from simply pursuing scale to focusing on cost efficiency.

Market impact

Although Cipher's total computing power remains substantial, switching to natural gas power generation could indirectly affect BTC supply and demand. More stable natural-gas-powered computing capacity could ease pressure from miners shutting down, providing slight support for the BTC price. However, the impact is highly indirect. More importantly, it remains to be seen whether the BTC price can continue to sustain miners' profits. If BTC remains weak, mining capacity may continue to shut down, even if energy costs come down.

Trading perspective

BTC is currently facing resistance at $77,016. If miners continue to operate at a loss, capacity coming offline would be bearish for the price. Cipher's move to natural gas is a response, but its effectiveness depends on how natural gas prices move and how they align with the BTC price. Put simply: stable computing power does not mean BTC is stable.

算力服务商 Cipher 刚宣布缩减电网供电的算力扩张计划，从 4.6 GW 降至 3.4 GW，转而加大天然气发电的支持力度，目标达到 5.9 GW 总算力。这个决定背后是比特币挖矿收入下滑，Cipher 想靠多元化能源组合自救。

为什么这条新闻重要？
算力服务商普遍在经历成本危机。随着 BTC 主网难度持续上升，挖矿算力成本越来越高，收入却受价格影响波动。Cipher 主动调整能源结构，意味着行业开始认真考虑除传统电网外的替代方案，天然气因为成本相对稳定、供应可控，可能成为新宠。这反映了算力行业从单纯追求数量到注重成本效益的转变。

对市场的影响

当前 BTC 在 $77,016 位置承压，如果矿工继续亏损，算力出清对价格是利空。 Cipher 转向天然气虽是应对策略，但效果取决于天然气价格走势和 BTC 价格的配合度。简单说：算力稳定不等于 BTC 就稳了。

ETH | October 31 proof of reserves can be independently verified | I’m more concerned about liquidity after the snapshot

My stance is to watch cautiously. The currently trending topic on Binance Square, “#Binance October 31 proof-of-reserves snapshot: zero-knowledge proof generated,” is directly relevant to ETH holders. Binance’s fifth security recovery announcement on November 2 stated that the complete zero-knowledge proof for the reserve snapshot taken at 08:00 Beijing time on October 31 had been generated. Binance users holding ETH and nine other tokens can use the verification tool on the official proof-of-reserves page to check whether their balances are included in at least 1:1 coverage. Binance’s verified official News account also reiterated the same update. The most important points here are that “users can verify for themselves” and the “snapshot time.” The proof for October 31 should not be described as a real-time audit of balances every second as of this moment.

I look at proof of reserves in three layers: first, whether my account balance is included in the Merkle tree; second, the relationship between the covered assets and user balances established by the zero-knowledge proof; and third, whether the platform continues to process actual withdrawals reliably after the snapshot. The first two layers improve verifiability; the third still needs to be monitored through the latest status page and subsequent announcements. Binance announced plans to take another snapshot on November 4, expand the range of tokens covered, and said it expects the new proof calculation to take 40 to 50 hours. This is a plan, not something that should be treated as completed in advance. Recent withdrawals of additional tokens on the ETH mainnet are also being restored in phases by asset and network; that does not mean all the mentioned tokens are available at the same time.

The impact on ETH’s price is not straightforward. Improved custody confidence could ease the risk discount applied to exchanges, but proof of reserves does not automatically create buying demand for ETH, and users withdrawing ETH from the platform cannot be directly equated with selling. On the institutional side, the November 2 U.S. ETH spot fund table from Farside showed combined net outflows of about $139.7 million, including $138.3 million from ETHA. These fund flows are a separate area to monitor from Binance’s proof of reserves. The Federal Reserve also kept its target range at 3.75% to 4%; today’s proof did not change that.

The current market picture: the latest Kraken ETH/USD trade was around $2,261.98, with a 24-hour low of $2,233.51 and a high of $2,300. title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they make to each other. The exchange merely collects and distributes the payments; it doesn’t profit from them.

【Mechanism】Perpetual contracts have no settlement date, so how does the price stay in line with the spot price? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is above the spot price (strong bullish sentiment) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is below the spot price (sellers have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money moves between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

【Step 1】Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, that’s 10% of the position size.
【Step 2】The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
【Step 3】Maintenance margin level: When losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

translatedData.content:
【If ETH falls below 2,000, the first thing to break may not be the coin, but confidence】

Let me start with an extreme hypothetical: if ETH suddenly fell below 2,000, would holders start questioning whether “blockchain can actually make money”? I’ve seen this play out in both 2017 and 2021. Everyone talks about going all in without thinking, but once the price breaks below a key level, discussion dies down first, and finger-pointing starts soon after.

Market sentiment has already been pushed into fear territory. The FNG is just 26, while the weekly average is 37 and still falling. Even more striking, Ether saw a record $1.61 billion in net outflows over the month. Meanwhile, in the wake of the Binance hack, Bitmine is still buying ETH, with corporate holdings moving toward a target of 5% of the supply.

What does this tell us? Money is flowing out, but someone is still picking up the coins. Short-term sentiment and the medium-term narrative are at odds. My personal take is that Bitmine’s strategy isn’t about “getting a better price after a drop.” It’s a bet that ETH will continue to become a core asset that can be allocated to, used as collateral, and settled with. Whether that thesis holds up will ultimately depend on whether companies merely put ETH on their balance sheets, or can actually borrow against it, generate returns, and withstand volatility. If they can’t, they’re just piling risk into a bigger pocket.

Those hit most directly are the people who bought near the top and are heavily leveraged; those hurt most are the latecomers who treated corporate crypto hoarding as a “new narrative.” Whether this story is about catching falling knives or building positions, the market will provide the answer—it just won’t tell you in advance.

How are you feeling right now? After this drop, are there more people itching to buy, or more people actually willing to go in big?

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

📰 Why Has U.S. Jobs Data Become a “Cash Machine” for Crypto?

The U.S. Department of Labor will release its October employment reports on November 3 and 6. The data drawing the most market attention are the nonfarm payrolls and wage growth figures, due on the 6th. These figures not only influence the Federal Reserve’s interest rate decisions, but have also unexpectedly become a “barometer” for the crypto market. Strong data could boost expectations of Fed rate hikes and weigh on risk assets, while weaker-than-expected data could lift market sentiment and temporarily benefit cryptocurrencies. For BTC and ETH, how the market digests the report’s “details” matters more than any single headline figure.

Why does this news matter?
This jobs report matters because it reveals the true health of the U.S. economy, a key factor in the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy decisions. The pace of Fed rate hikes directly affects the strength of the U.S. dollar and, in turn, global capital flows. As risk-sensitive assets, cryptocurrencies are highly responsive to the Fed’s policy direction. Historical data show that when employment figures exceed expectations, rate hike expectations tend to rise, potentially strengthening the dollar and putting pressure on global equities and other risk assets. Conversely, weaker-than-expected employment data may lead markets to expect the Fed to slow the pace of tightening, potentially benefiting risk assets in the short term. For crypto, this means the report’s “details” are crucial. For example, strong job growth alongside weak wage growth could signal an overheated economy but insufficient purchasing power, which may not necessarily sustain expectations for more aggressive Fed rate hikes. Conversely, if both employment and wage figures improve, that could reinforce expectations of continued Fed tightening. This means the market needs to pay attention both to the data itself and to how it interprets the figures.

Market impact
U.S. employment data affect the crypto market primarily through the following channels:
1. **Fed expectations**: Employment data directly shape market expectations for the scale of Fed rate hikes. If the figures are strong, markets may expect another rate hike in December or a longer hiking cycle. The dollar could strengthen, and capital could flow out of risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
2. **Shifts in risk appetite**: Employment figures directly affect market risk appetite. Strong data could make investors more concerned about asset bubbles and less willing to allocate funds to highly volatile assets such as cryptocurrencies.
3. **Capital flow indicators**: Weaker-than-expected employment data could spark concerns about an economic slowdown. Some capital may flow out of traditional assets such as stocks in search of safe havens or in anticipation of looser policy, potentially benefiting cryptocurrencies temporarily. Historically, however, these inflows have often been short-lived because cryptocurrencies lack fundamental support.
For BTC and ETH specifically, if the market has already fully priced in expectations of Fed rate hikes, the employment data may affect short-term sentiment more than alter the medium- to long-term trend. But if the data differ sharply from market expectations, they could trigger significant short-term volatility. For example, if employment figures far exceed expectations and strengthen expectations of a 75-basis-point Fed rate hike in December, BTC could come under pressure and fall toward $74,000. Conversely, if the data fall short of expectations and markets anticipate a slower pace of tightening, BTC could briefly rebound to $77,500. Historically, though, cryptocurrencies’ reactions to macroeconomic events like these have often been short-lived, as their prices are driven more by fundamentals and technical factors.

Trading approach
The report is likely to affect cryptocurrencies mainly through sentiment and could increase volatility in the short term. BTC may choose a direction within the $74,000–$77,000 range, but this outlook would be invalidated if the Fed holds its December hike at 50 basis points or if the employment data are merely average. Simply put: if stronger-than-expected employment data lead the Fed to continue raising rates, BTC could fall toward $74,000; if the data fall short of expectations and the market anticipates slower tightening, BTC could briefly rebound to $77,500.

📰 为什么美国就业数据成了加密货币的“提款机”？

美国劳工部将在11月3日和6日公布10月就业报告，特别是6日公布的非农就业人数和薪资增速数据最受市场关注。这份数据不仅决定美联储利率走向，也意外成为加密货币市场的“风向标”——因为数据显示强劲，美联储加息预期会增强，压制风险资产；而数据不及预期，则可能让市场乐观，加密货币会阶段性受益。对BTC和ETH来说，市场如何消化这份报告的“细节”比单一结果更重要。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这份就业报告之所以重要，是因为它揭示了美国经济的真实健康状况，这是美联储调整货币政策的关键依据。美联储加息的节奏直接影响美元强弱，进而影响全球资金流向。加密货币作为风险偏好资产，对美联储的政策方向极为敏感。历史数据显示，当就业数据超预期时，美联储加息预期会升温，美元可能走强，全球股票等风险资产承压；反之，如果就业数据不及预期，市场可能会预期美联储放缓紧缩步伐，风险资产可能阶段性受益。对加密货币来说，这意味着报告中的“细节”至关重要。例如，如果就业人数增长强劲但薪资增速疲软，可能显示经济过热但购买力不足，这未必会持续提振美联储加息力度；反之，如果就业和薪资数据同步向好，则可能强化美联储持续紧缩的预期。这意味着市场需要关注数据本身，以及市场如何解读这些数据。

对市场的影响
美国就业数据主要通过以下路径影响加密货币市场：
1. **美联储预期传导**：就业数据直接决定市场对美联储加息的预期强度。如果数据强劲，市场可能预期12月继续加息，或加息周期延长，美元可能走强，资金可能从风险资产流出，包括加密货币。
2. **风险偏好变化**：就业数据表现会直接影响市场风险偏好。强劲数据可能让投资者更担心资产泡沫，降低对加密货币这类高波动性资产的配置意愿。
3. **资金流向指标**：如果就业数据不及预期，可能会引发对经济放缓的担忧，部分资金可能从股市等传统资产流出，寻找避风港或博弈宽松政策，加密货币可能阶段性受益。但历史上，这种流入往往短暂，因为加密货币缺乏基本面支撑。
具体到BTC和ETH，如果市场对美联储加息预期已有充分消化，那么就业数据本身可能更多影响短期情绪波动，而不是改变中长期趋势。但如果数据与市场预期大相径庭，可能导致短期剧烈波动。例如，如果就业数据远超预期，导致美联储12月加息75基点预期强化，BTC可能承压至$74,000附近；反之，如果数据不及预期，市场可能预期美联储放缓紧缩，BTC可能短暂反弹至$77,500。但加密货币历史上对这类宏观事件的反应往往是短暂的，因为其价格更多由基本面和技术面驱动。

操作思路
这份报告对加密货币的影响更多是情绪层面的，短期内可能导致波动加剧。BTC在$74,000-$77,000区间可能出现方向选择，但这个判断如果美联储12月维持50基点加息，或就业数据仅表现一般，则作废。简单说：如果就业数据超预期引发美联储继续加息，BTC可能下探$74,000；如果数据不及预期且市场预期放缓紧缩，BTC可能短暂反弹至$77,500。

subTitle:

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

Most people think native coins and tokens are straightforward, but this is where it's easy to get confused:
A native coin is an asset built into a blockchain itself, such as BTC on the Bitcoin network, ETH on Ethereum, and BNB on BNB Smart Chain.
Native coins are recorded and issued by the consensus rules themselves, while token balances are recorded in the corresponding contract, and the rules depend on how the contract code is written.
Before buying a new token, verify the contract address through official channels. Having the same name and ticker doesn't mean it's the same token.

当前 BTC 和 ETH 价格走势显示市场更受美联储政策和市场情绪影响，Tether 的机器人投资目前更像是一种情绪支撑而非直接驱动力。如果短期内 $BTC 不能突破 77K 这个技术压力，那么产业级应用的投资逻辑就需要重新评估。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Let me explain it in plain English today.

[The basics] Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U in principal and use 10x leverage, you’re actually controlling a
1,000U position. If the price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss of your principal—remember, the loss is calculated based on your total borrowed position.

[The cost] With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by around 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of around 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact level also depends on the margin ratio).

Xiaoyan’s mini-class is starting! 🙈
A Complete Guide to the Bollinger Bands (BOLL) Trading Indicator (Part 1)
Learn to identify trends, spot breakouts, and find trading opportunities!
Bollinger Bands (often abbreviated as BOLL) are a classic technical analysis indicator, mainly used to assess market volatility, trend direction, and potential breakout opportunities.
They consist of three bands: the upper band, the middle band, and the lower band.

I. The Three Bollinger Bands
1. Upper Band (Resistance Reference Line)
This represents the upper boundary of the price range. When the price approaches the upper band, it is relatively high within its recent range, but that does not necessarily mean it will fall.
2. Middle Band (Trend Reference Line)
This is usually a 20-period simple moving average (SMA).
Price above the middle band: bulls have the relative advantage.
Price below the middle band: bears have the relative advantage.
Middle band sloping upward: the trend is relatively strong.
Middle band sloping downward: the trend is relatively weak.
3. Lower Band (Support Reference Line)
This represents the lower boundary of the price range. When the price approaches the lower band, it is relatively low within its recent range, but that does not necessarily mean it will rebound.
The default settings are usually a 20-period lookback and 2 standard deviations.

II. The Five Most Important Bollinger Band Patterns
1. Bollinger Band Squeeze
The upper and lower bands gradually move closer together, narrowing the channel. This indicates that market volatility is falling, and the market may be in a consolidation phase.
Trading idea: Wait for a high-volume breakout above the upper band or below the lower band before assessing the direction. Don’t try to predict the move in advance.
2. Bollinger Band Expansion
The upper and lower bands gradually widen, indicating that market volatility is increasing.
Expansion to the upside: Watch for a bullish trend.
Expansion to the downside: Watch for a bearish trend.
3. Riding the Upper Band
When the price stays close to the upper band, upward momentum may be strong. Don’t blindly short just because the price touches the upper band—a strong trend may continue to run along it.
4. Riding the Lower Band
When the price stays close to the lower band, bears may have the advantage. Don’t blindly buy the dip just because the price touches the lower band.
5. False Breakout
If the price breaks above the upper band or below the lower band, then quickly returns inside the channel, it may be a false breakout.
Confirm it by checking trading volume, the candlestick’s closing position, and subsequent price action.

小雁小课堂开始啦！🙈
布林线（BOLL）交易指标知识全解（上）
学会判断趋势、识别突破与寻找交易机会！
布林线（Bollinger Bands，简称 BOLL）是技术分析中非常经典的指标，主要用于判断市场波动率、趋势方向以及潜在的突破机会。
它由三条轨道组成：上轨、中轨、下轨。

一、布林线的三条轨道
1. 上轨（压力参考线）
代表价格波动区间的上边界。当价格接近上轨，说明价格处于近期波动区间的相对高位，但不代表一定会下跌。
2. 中轨（趋势参考线）
通常采用20周期简单移动平均线（SMA）。
价格在中轨上方：多头相对占优。
价格在中轨下方：空头相对占优。
中轨向上：趋势偏强。
中轨向下：趋势偏弱。
3. 下轨（支撑参考线）
代表价格波动区间的下边界。当价格接近下轨，说明价格处于近期波动区间的相对低位，但不代表一定会反弹。
默认参数通常为：周期20，标准差2。

二、布林线最重要的五种形态
1. 布林线收口
上下轨逐渐靠拢，通道越来越窄，说明市场波动率正在下降，行情可能处于整理阶段。
交易思路：等待价格放量突破上轨或下轨，再判断方向，不要提前猜涨跌。
2. 布林线开口
上下轨逐渐扩张，说明市场波动率正在增加。
向上开口：关注多头趋势。
向下开口：关注空头趋势。
3. 沿上轨运行
价格连续贴近上轨，说明上涨动能可能较强。不要看到触碰上轨就盲目做空，强势行情可能持续沿上轨运行。
4. 沿下轨运行
价格连续贴近下轨，说明空头可能占据优势。不要因为价格触碰下轨就盲目抄底。
5. 假突破
价格突破上轨或下轨后，很快重新回到通道内部，可能是假突破。
需要结合成交量、K线收盘位置和后续走势进行确认。

Ethereum Foundation highlights public infrastructure｜Bhutan’s digital identity is an existing case｜ETH around $2,252: wait and see

I recognize the long-term value of real-world use cases, but I’m not interpreting an ecosystem article today as an immediate buying catalyst for ETH. On November 3, the Ethereum Foundation published a feature on “digital public infrastructure” and launched a dedicated resource site, discussing how governments and nonprofits can use independently verifiable shared networks to coordinate services. The article cites Bhutan’s National Digital Identity (NDI) as an example: individuals keep their digital credentials in their own wallets, while shared on-chain registry information is used to verify issuers and credential types. Personal data itself is not made public on-chain. Bhutan’s NDI website had already announced its integration with Ethereum in October 2025; today’s announcement is therefore the Foundation’s presentation and documentation of an existing initiative, not a new contract or grant announcing that “Bhutan has only just adopted Ethereum today.”

Why does this mechanism matter to crypto markets? If public services can verify records while reducing reliance on a single operator, that shows public blockchains have uses beyond payment speculation and could attract developers and long-term infrastructure investment. But between an application’s existence and a rise in ETH’s price lie actual transaction frequency, fee payments, activity shifting to scaling layers, and demand to hold ETH. The Bhutan case page specifically notes that not every credential issuance and verification requires a transaction on Ethereum mainnet; governance authorities still decide who is eligible to issue credentials, and the chain itself does not guarantee that credential contents are correct. So you can’t simply multiply NDI user numbers by mainnet fees, much less present the Foundation’s feature as a major government purchase of ETH.

For now, fund flows don’t support chasing a rally. Farside’s table shows that on November 2, U.S. Ethereum funds saw combined net outflows of about $139.7 million, including about $138.3 million from ETHA; the table updates automatically, so figures may still be revised. The Foundation’s ecosystem narrative addresses long-term usability, while fund subscriptions and redemptions reflect recent allocation appetite—the two operate on different time scales. ETH is marked as gaining traction among Binance Square’s most-searched terms, but the current trending list has no precise topic tag directly related to this feature, so I’m only noting the asset being discussed and won’t borrow unrelated trending topics.

The market is already showing caution: when I checked Kraken ETH/USD, it was around $2,251.78, with a 24-hour range of about $2,233.51–$2,301.21. $2,233.5 is the immediate floor and $2,301.2 is the ceiling; if the price fails to hold above the floor, the long-term application story can’t offset short-term risk. If fund outflows narrow significantly and the price reclaims $2,301.2 convincingly, I’ll become more optimistic about a recovery in demand. If the feature is not followed by new verifiable projects and usage data, I’ll give it less weight in my trading decisions.

If I were trading this myself: I wouldn’t enter now; my outlook is neutral, with a position size of 0% of total capital. After entry, if an hourly close falls back below $2,250, I’d close the entire position at a loss. If the price breaks below $2,233.5 first, I’d cancel the entry plan. If none of these conditions are met, I’ll keep watching.

以太坊基金会发布公共基建专题｜不丹数字身份是既有案例｜ETH约2252美元先观察

我的态度是认可真实使用场景的长期价值，但今天不把一篇生态文章解读成 ETH 的即时买盘。以太坊基金会 11 月 3 日发布“面向数字公共基础设施”的专题，并上线独立资料站，讨论政府、非营利组织怎样用可独立验证的共享网络协调服务。文章举不丹国家数字身份 NDI 为例：个人把数字凭证留在自己的钱包，链上的共享注册信息用于核验签发者和凭证类型，个人资料本身不公开上链。不丹 NDI 官网早在 2025 年 10 月就宣布与以太坊集成；因此今天是基金会整理与展示现有实践，不是“不丹今天才采用以太坊”的新合同或新拨款。

这个机制为什么与加密市场有关？公共服务若能验证记录且减少对单一运营方的依赖，说明公链有支付投机以外的使用空间，可能吸引开发者和长期基础设施投入。但从应用存在到 ETH 价格上涨，中间还隔着实际交易频次、费用支付、扩容层分流和持币需求。不丹案例页特别说明，并非每张凭证的签发和验证都要在以太坊主网发交易；治理部门仍决定谁有资格签发，链本身也不担保凭证内容正确。因此不能拿 NDI 用户数直接乘以主网手续费，更不能把基金会专题写成政府大额购买 ETH。

资金面暂时不配合追涨。Farside 表格显示 11 月 2 日美国以太坊基金合计净流出约 1.397 亿美元，其中 ETHA 流出约 1.383 亿美元；表格自动更新，后续仍可能修订。基金会的生态叙事解决的是长期可用性问题，基金申赎则反映近期配置意愿，二者时间尺度不同。币安广场最常搜索中 ETH 标注热度上升，但当前热榜没有与该专题直接对应的准确话题标签，所以只标记讨论币种，不借无关热点。

市场已反映出谨慎：我查看 Kraken ETH/USD 时约 2251.78 美元，24 小时区间约 2233.51—2301.21 美元。2233.5 是眼前下沿，2301.2 是上沿；若价格守不住下沿，长期应用故事也不能抵消短线风险。若基金流出明显收窄、且价格有效站回 2301.2，我会提高对需求恢复的判断；若专题后续没有新增可核验项目和使用数据，我会降低它对交易决策的权重。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，方向中性，仓位为总资金的 0%。只有 ETH 连续两根一小时 K 线收在 2301.2 美元上方，且下一次基金数据不再出现大额净流出，我才考虑用总资金 3% 做现货试仓，不加杠杆。第一目标 2350 美元，到位减半；第二目标 2420 美元，余仓分批退出。入场后若一小时收盘跌回 2250 美元下方，止损全数平仓；若先跌破 2233.5，则取消入场计划。条件未触发就继续观察。

来源：以太坊基金会 11 月 3 日文章及公共基建案例站、不丹 NDI 官网、Farside、Kraken。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

【The more ETH falls, the harder it is to find a “real bargain”—why?】

Lately, as I’ve been watching ETH, the mistake I’m most wary of is assuming that a steep drop means it must be cheap. The Fear and Greed Index is down to just 26, and the weekly average of 37 is still falling. ETH is caught between support at 2190.6 and resistance at 2346.76, yet trading volume hasn’t dried up. The selling pressure is real, and so is market participation.

What changed my perspective is the growing divergence in capital flows. Spot ETH ETFs saw net outflows of $1.61 billion in October, while Bitmine continued accumulating, with a target of nearly 5% of the total supply. Outflows and accumulation are happening at the same time; it’s still too early to say which side is right.

Even more striking, ETH was involved in the funds behind a suspected $106 million loss. In practical terms, this means exchanges, custodians, and institutions that use ETH for settlement or as collateral all face higher security, monitoring, and compliance costs. The business case isn’t “the coin’s price goes up, so you make money”; it’s whether capital is willing to stay and whether the cost of using it can come down.

So even though ETH is down 54.5% from its peak, I wouldn’t automatically call it cheap. BTC’s 59.3% market share shows that capital still favors mainstream coins. For ETH to achieve real-world adoption, it needs to prove that people will keep using, pledging, and holding it even in a weak market.

What I’m wrestling with now is this: if sentiment keeps outweighing fundamentals, will support hold? Which matters more to you: ETF flows or real-world usage?

#ETH #加密分析 #HYPE #Market Insights

【ETH越跌，为什么越难等到“真便宜”？】

这段时间盯ETH，我最警惕的误判是：跌得多，就等于该便宜了。恐慌贪婪指数只剩26，周均37还在下行；ETH夹在2190.6支撑与2346.76阻力之间，成交量却没凉。卖压是真的，资金参与也是真的。

让我改观的是资金开始分化。ETH现货ETF十月净流出16.1亿美元，Bitmine却继续增持，目标是接近供应量的5%。撤出与囤货同时发生，谁对谁错，答案还没出来。

更扎眼的是，那起疑似1.06亿美元损失的资金曾经过ETH。落到实处，这意味着交易所、托管方，以及把ETH当结算或抵押工具的机构，都得承担更高的安全、监控与合规成本。商业逻辑不是“币价涨就能赚”，而是资金是否愿意留下、使用成本能否下降。

所以ETH较高点回撤54.5%，我不会直接翻译成便宜。BTC市场占比59.3%说明资金仍偏主流币；ETH要真正落地，得证明弱市中仍有人持续使用、抵押和持有。

我现在卡住的是：情绪继续压过基本面，支撑是否守得住？你更看重ETF流向，还是真实使用？

本金几百上千U的朋友最焦虑：这么点钱怎么翻身？先说结论：小资金的
优势恰恰是「船小好调头」，别拿大资金的打法硬套。

【三个建议】1. 合约杠杆别超过5倍，小本金最大的敌人是归零，不是
赚得慢；2. 把80%精力从「找百倍币」挪到「练执行」——同样是练手，
拿小仓位在BTC/ETH上练，比在小币上练生存率高得多（至少不容易
被一根针带走）；3. 每月有结余就补点本金，本金曲线平滑上升，比

📰 Why Could Circle’s Stablecoin Petition Shake the Entire Crypto Market?

Circle just sent a letter to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), asking how qualifying payment stablecoins should be treated: should they be regulated as complexly as ordinary cryptocurrencies, or given a simpler set of rules? This could have a major impact on the stablecoin sector, especially since Circle’s USDC is worth tens of billions of dollars.

Why does this news matter?
There’s a lot going on behind the scenes. Stablecoins were designed for payments, but the SEC has treated them like cryptocurrencies, forcing many companies to redo their tax filings and driving up costs. Circle is now making its case directly: these are payment tools, so don’t burden them with complicated rules. Why does that matter? The SEC is considering changing its rules. It could either revise the rules for all stablecoins or create a separate, more favorable category for payment stablecoins. The first option would mean a major overhaul for the whole industry; the second would be a big win for USDC.

Market impact
In the short term, this news could affect sentiment around BTC and ETH. If the SEC does ease up, funds could flow back into stablecoins, which could boost BTC and ETH. But over the longer term, if stablecoins remain trapped under complex regulations, people may pay more attention to established assets like Bitcoin. Have there been similar events in the past? Of course—for example, when Facebook proposed Libra, the crypto world was rocked by the news.

💡 This could matter even more for ETH, given that USDC is the king of stablecoins by supply. If the SEC creates a separate category for payment stablecoins, major assets like ETH could benefit from increased confidence in the stablecoin market as a whole. This view would not hold, however, if the premise is wrong—for example, if the SEC continues its crackdown.

This article was not sponsored by any project. The author does not hold any of the assets mentioned.

$BTC $ETH #BTC #ETH

📰 为什么 Circle 的稳定币请愿能撼动整个加密市场？

Circle 公司刚给美国证券交易委员会（SEC）递了封信，想搞清楚合格支付稳定币应该怎么算账——是按普通加密货币那么复杂，还是给个更简单的过路费？这事儿对稳定币领域影响挺大的，毕竟 Circle 手里的 USDC 值着几百亿呢。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这背后其实是个大瓜。稳定币本来想走支付路线，结果被 SEC 当成加密货币管，导致很多公司要重新报税，成本激增。Circle 这下是直接喊话：我们这玩意儿就是交钱工具，别用复杂规则折腾。为啥重要？因为 SEC 要改规则，要么得改所有稳定币，要么就单独开个支付类别的绿灯。前者意味着整个行业得重做，后者就是给 USDC 摇旗呐喊。

对市场的影响
短期内看，BTC 和 ETH 可能会因为这个消息情绪波动。如果 SEC 真松口，稳定币的资金可能会回流，对 BTC 和 ETH 是提振。但长期看，如果稳定币还是被套在复杂监管里，大家可能会更关注像比特币这种老牌资产。历史上有类似事件吗？当然有，比如当年 Facebook 提出 Libra 时，加密圈也是惊涛骇浪。

💡 这事儿对 ETH 的意义可能更大，毕竟 USDC 量是稳定币之王。如果 SEC 真把支付稳定币单独列出，ETH 这种大饼可能会受益于整个稳定币市场的信心提升。如果这个判断有偏差，比如 SEC 持续打压，这个看法就不成立了。

Will trading U.S. stock perpetuals on overseas exchanges really get you taxed as derivatives by South Korea’s tax authority? The Finance Ministry has just tapped the brakes.

According to reports citing statements from Foresight News and others, South Korea’s Ministry of Economy and Finance said reports claiming that perpetual contracts and similar products on overseas virtual asset exchanges had been classified as derivatives and made taxable were untrue. It specifically responded to an article in the Maeil Business Newspaper. The ministry also stressed that no decision has yet been made on whether or how products on overseas virtual asset exchanges will be taxed.

A few points that matter directly to everyday traders 👇
🔹 What was denied: The Maeil Business Newspaper previously reported that the Finance Ministry had decided to classify perpetual contracts linked to U.S. stocks as overseas stock derivatives and include them under capital gains tax. From 2027, annual profits from trading these products on overseas crypto exchanges would reportedly be taxed at around 11% after an exemption of roughly 2.5 million won—about half the 22% rate on overseas spot stocks.
🔹 The official position: It’s not “the tax has been finalized and will take effect,” but rather “the reports are inaccurate, and no plan has been finalized.” The ministry’s direct response shows it is actively clarifying the matter, not tacitly confirming it by staying silent.
🔹 Don’t confuse this with another tax story today: Someone on the ruling party’s tax subcommittee has suggested delaying virtual asset taxation as a whole. That’s a separate legislative discussion; this story is specifically about whether overseas exchange/U.S. stock perpetuals count as derivatives and how they would be taxed.
🔹 What this means for traders: Don’t change your positions or move funds in the short term on the assumption that the 11% tax is already in force. But don’t assume perpetuals will never be taxed either—the decision is still pending, and the final outcome will depend on tax law revisions and detailed enforcement rules.

In a nutshell: The clickbait headline says “tax confirmed”; the ministry says “not decided yet.” Following the Finance Ministry’s statements and any subsequent draft legislation is more reliable than relying on reposted screenshots.

Are you more concerned about a separate tax on overseas perpetuals, or another overhaul of the overall virtual asset tax framework?

在海外交易所玩美股永续，到底会不会被韩国税务局按衍生品收税？财政部这会儿先踩了一脚刹车。

据 Foresight News 等援引说明：韩国财政经济部回应称，「海外虚拟资产交易所永续合约等已被认定为衍生品并征税」的相关报道不属实，并点名回应了《每日经济》文章。官方还强调——对海外虚拟资产交易所上的产品，是否征税、用什么方式征，目前尚未作出决定。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇
🔹 被否认的是什么：此前《每日经济》称，财政部已决定把挂钩美股的永续合约归为海外股票衍生品，纳入资本利得税；自 2027 年起，经海外加密交易所交易此类产品的年收益，在扣除约 250 万韩元基本扣除额后，按约 11% 计税（约为海外股票现货税率 22% 的一半）。
🔹 官方口径：不是「已定案开征」，而是「报道不实、方案未定」。点名回应说明部委在主动澄清，不是沉默默认。
🔹 和今天另一条税新闻别混：执政党再经委有人建议把「虚拟资产征税」整体再往后拖，那是另一条立法讨论；本条只盯「海外所永续/美股永续算不算衍生品、怎么征」。
🔹 对交易者意味着什么：短期别按「11% 已落地」去改仓或搬家；也别以为永远不征——只是决策窗口还开着，最终仍看税法修订与征管细则。

一句话：标题党说「已征税」，部委说「还没定」。盯财政部说明和后续草案，比盯转发截图更靠谱。

你更担心海外永续被单独加税，还是整体虚拟资产税表又要再改一轮？

#韩财政部否认永续合约征税报道 #BTC #ETH

I'm a little concerned: could ETH become increasingly dominated by institutions over time?
Bitmine previously disclosed that it holds around 6.03 million ETH, of which more than 5.06 million has already been staked.
What does that amount mean? It's close to 4.9% of ETH's total supply.
A lot of people see this and get excited, thinking that with institutions buying so much, ETH is bound to have a bright future.
But I'd like to offer a reminder: don't just look at how much it's buying—look at why it's buying.
Institutions aren't just hoarding ETH to bet on its price going up. They can also earn returns through staking and even build financing and financial services businesses around ETH.
Of course, this benefits the ETH ecosystem.
But there's a very real flip side: if more and more ETH ends up in the hands of a few large institutions, could that create new concentration risks in the market?
I don't think institutional buying necessarily means retail investors are guaranteed to make money.
#ETH  #以太  #Bitmine  #机构持仓  #币安

我有点担心，ETH以后会不会越来越像机构的筹码？
Bitmine此前披露，自己持有约603万枚ETH，其中超过506万枚已经拿去质押。
这个数量是什么概念？接近ETH总供应量的4.9%。
很多人看到这里就开始兴奋，觉得机构这么买，ETH肯定有戏。
但我反而想提醒一句：别只看它买了多少，还要看它为什么买。
机构囤ETH，不光是赌币价上涨，还能通过质押获得收益，甚至围绕ETH建立融资和金融业务。
这对ETH生态当然有帮助。
但另一面也很现实：如果越来越多ETH集中在少数大型机构手里，市场会不会出现新的集中风险？
我不觉得机构买入就等于散户一定能赚钱。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What’s the Deal with a Blockchain’s Fuel?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay Gas fees to transfer funds, and you pay Gas fees to mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel money.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they choose late-night hours or quiet market periods for on-chain operations. The same operation can cost half as much.

ETH funds see net redemptions again | About $139.7 million flowed out on Nov. 2 | No rush to buy the dip near $2,250

My stance is to wait and see for now, and first wait for funding pressure and price to turn together. ETH is gaining traction among the most-searched topics on Binance Square over the past six hours, but buzz cannot replace actual subscriptions and redemptions. Farside’s latest table of U.S. spot Ethereum funds shows total net outflows of about $139.7 million on Nov. 2, including about $138.3 million from BlackRock’s ETHA and about $4.6 million from ETHB, while one other fund saw inflows of about $3.2 million. The same table showed net outflows of $155.7 million on Oct. 30. The direction over two consecutive trading days is worth watching, though single-day figures may still be revised.

I look at this aggregate table separately from the issuer’s own page. BlackRock iShares’ website lists ETHA’s net asset value on Nov. 2 as $50.85, up $0.43 from the previous day, and reports about 136.8 million shares outstanding that day. NAV can rise at the same time as a fund sees net redemptions: the former mainly tracks the price of ETH, while the latter reflects the net amount of share creation or redemption in the primary market. A rise in an ETF’s NAV does not mean institutional money is flowing back in, just as outflows do not mean every holder is selling. The issuer’s figures and Farside’s statistics use different methodologies, so I won’t treat a one-day change in assets under management as a direct measure of net flows.

Why does this affect spot ETH? If fund shares continue to see net redemptions, hedging by authorized participants and adjustments to underlying assets could add selling pressure, or at least weaken marginal buying support during rallies. But the trading process involves time lags, so a single candlestick cannot be attributed entirely to ETFs. Meanwhile, on Oct. 28, the Federal Reserve kept the federal funds target range at 3.75% to 4%, so risk assets still face constraints from the cost of capital. The Ethereum Foundation’s announcement that Glamsterdam’s launch on the Hoodi testnet has been delayed gave no new activation date either; discussions at developer meetings are not a reason to buy as if the upgrade were already live.

How has the market reacted so far? When I checked Kraken spot ETH, it was around $2,250, with a rolling 24-hour low of $2,233.51 and high of $2,301.21. Price is near the lower half of the range and has yet to stage a strong recovery after the outflows. My key levels are $2,233 for support, $2,260 for a short-term reclaim, and confirmation above $2,301. If price breaks below $2,233 and then fails to reclaim it on a rebound, my short-term bearish view remains in place. If it holds above $2,301 consecutively and fund flows improve on the next trading day, that would invalidate my current wait-and-see stance. Weekend and pre-market price swings are no substitute for final data from U.S. fund trading days.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I’d consider is a small spot long; I wouldn’t chase shorts or use high leverage. I’d only test the waters with at most 4% of total capital if price holds above $2,301 and successfully retests it, and fund flows stop showing increasingly large net outflows. The initial target would be $2,340, where I’d halve the position, with a target of $2,380 for the remainder. I’d place the initial stop below $2,260, and close early if price falls back below $2,233 or subsequent fund data shows larger consecutive outflows. If all the conditions aren’t met, I’d remain on the sidelines. These price levels are just a plan, not records of executed trades.

我把这张汇总表和发行人页面分开看。贝莱德iShares官网把ETHA的11月2日基金净值列为50.85美元，较前一日增加0.43美元，同时列示当日已发行份额约1.368亿。净值上涨与基金净赎回可以同时发生：前者主要跟随ETH价格，后者反映一级市场份额创建或赎回的净额；不能因为ETF的净值收涨就宣布机构资金回流，也不能因为资金流出就断言每个持有人都在卖。发行人页面与Farside的统计口径不同，我不会拿资产规模一天的变化直接当作净流量。

为什么这会影响现货ETH？若基金份额持续净赎回，授权参与机构的对冲和底层资产调整可能增加卖盘，至少削弱上涨时的边际承接；但交易链条有时间差，不能把某一根K线全部归因于ETF。与此同时，美联储10月28日维持联邦基金利率目标区间在3.75%至4%，风险资产仍面对资金成本约束。以太坊基金会对Glamsterdam在Hoodi测试网的延期公告也没有给出新激活日期，开发者会议上的讨论不能当成升级已上线的买入理由。

市场已如何反应？查看Kraken ETH现货时约2250美元，滚动24小时低点2233.51、高点2301.21；价格靠近区间下半段，尚未走出资金流出后的强势修复。我的关键位是2233防守、2260短线回收、2301上方确认。若跌破2233后反抽收不回，短线偏弱判断延续；若连续站稳2301且下一交易日基金申赎改善，当前观望判断才被推翻。周末和盘前的价格波动不能代替美国基金交易日的最终数据。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只考虑现货轻仓做多，不追空、不用高杠杆。只有价格站稳2301美元并回踩不破，且基金流量不再扩大净流出，才以总资金最多4%试单；目标先看2340美元，届时减仓一半，余仓目标2380美元。初始止损放在2260美元下方，若回落失守2233或基金后续出现更大连续流出，提前平仓。若触发条件不齐就继续空仓，所有价位只是计划，不是成交记录。

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

translatedData.subTitle:
You can’t trade crypto futures without USDT, but many people haven’t wondered why it’s worth $1.

[How it works] A stablecoin is operated by an issuer: you give it $1, it gives you 1 USDT, and puts
the dollars (and equivalent assets) into its reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars redeems it with the issuer
issuer to redeem it. This “mint-redeem” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
The price occasionally deviates slightly (for example, to 0.999), and arbitrageurs quickly bring it back in line.
